name: Why Do Bathroom Remodel Bids Vary So Much?

mainEntity.name: What causes bathroom remodel bids in Los Angeles County to vary so much?
mainEntity.text: What causes bathroom remodel bids in Los Angeles County to vary so much?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bathroom remodel bids can vary widely because contractors do not always price the same work. One bid may include full demolition, waterproofing, permit coordination, haul-away, and final cleanup, while another may leave those items out or price them as extras. Material allowances also make a big difference; a low allowance for tile or fixtures can make a bid look cheaper even though your actual selections will cost more. Labor rates, subcontractor quality, schedule speed, insurance, and project management overhead also affect pricing. In Los Angeles County, local permit experience and inspection coordination can add value that is not obvious in the initial number. Hidden condition allowances matter too, because older bathrooms may reveal rot, mold, old plumbing, or outdated electrical once walls are opened. The best way to compare bids is to request line-item detail and make sure every contractor is pricing the same scope. If a bid is unusually low, ask exactly what is excluded and what happens if surprises are found after demolition.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bid differences usually come from scope gaps, material allowances, labor quality, permit handling, insurance, and whether hidden conditions are included. One contractor may price full code-compliant work while another omits items like waterproofing, haul-away, or inspections. Comparing line items is the only reliable way to see why prices differ.
